content.value: Mr. Joy started Joy Travel Agency on 01 May 2023. The following activities occurred during the month:
May 01: Started services with cast tk. 42,000 and equipment tk. 65,000 funneled by Mr. Joy.
May 05: Received from customers tk. 17,000 for providing services.
May 07: Paid for internet and telephone bill tk. 5,000
May 10: Purchased supplies on account tk. 3,000
May 12: Took a bank loan tk. 75,000
May 15: Paid for salaries tk. 10,000, while tk. 3 ,000 remained unpaid.
May 24: Paid 2/3 of the due amount against purchased credit supplies.
May 26: Service provided but still unbilled tk. 35,000
May 29: Received a bill from ABC Ad. Agency and hold payment for later date tk. 7,000
May 30: Charged depreciation on equipment tk. 2,300
